chg-Latn/schluessel.reverse:
ʿAnūq ḥażrat-i Ādamniŋ qizlari erdi
ʿAnūq Ādamniŋ qizi erdi

en.accept: ʿAnūq was (the daughter of Adam|Adam's daughter).

chg-Latn/schluessel.reverse: Šahar wä taǧniŋ arasida bir bāǧ bar

en.accept: Between the (city|town) and the mountain there is a (garden|orchard).
(He|She) (used to go about|would go about|used to walk) in the wilderness.

chg-Latn/schluessel.reverse:
Daryāda baliq köp
Daryāda köp baliq bar

en.accept: There are many fish in the river.
(He|She) (used to swallow|would swallow) them bones and all.
